collection.title: Citroen Relay Van - Split Rear Door 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Citroen Relay 2016 - 2019 which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Relay which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
